authority: Human-supplied Primary APEX F-C1: approved for execution-request preparation only

base_stdlib_static_identity.algorithm: Recursive regular files below root, exclude site-packages and __pycache__ path components and .pyc; map relative POSIX path to SHA256, JSON sort_keys=True separators=(comma,colon), hash UTF-8 bytes. Recreate and preserve full map before and after future attempt.
base_stdlib_static_identity.limitation: Does not hash the entire OS/dyld dependency image; actual Python origins and native dependencies still require execution-time review.

identity_observed_by_static_read_only_in.shared_venv_pth_finding: Editable .pth points to current mutable repository src; also _virtualenv and distutils-precedence hooks. Do not execute probe via shared venv.

future_identity_checks.action: Read macOS SystemVersion.plist and uname; record actual system/build/architecture. Compare to this identity and stop for revised approval on drift; do not pretend a current inspection proves future identity.

Rehash executable/libpython/BUILD/patchlevel header and verify resolved executable remains outside all research worktrees. Future explicit non-timing identity preflight under this base executable -S records sys.executable, version, implementation, prefix/base_prefix, platform.machine and sys.path. Require CPython 3.12.14 arm64 with the pinned base prefix; no venv activation.

Copy only listed psutil bytes into the new dependency-only directory; verify exact file set and hashes, native ABI tag and metadata version. Future parent identity preflight imports psutil only after authority, records __version__, __file__, all loaded psutil module origins and loaded extension origin; require only this copied dependency root. No current psutil import occurred.

Verify base site-packages has no executable .pth/sitecustomize/usercustomize; audit pinned source paths for shadow startup modules. Parent -S suppresses site processing. Child does not inherit -S: it uses base CPython site processing, disabled user site, explicit PYTHONSAFEPATH and clean prefix. Stop on unexpected site/startup hooks.

Use the literal env -i command. PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX is fresh empty and bytecode writes disabled, preventing reuse of another branch cache. Parent sys.path exposes only copied psutil in addition to vetted base stdlib and pinned scripts. Child PYTHONPATH is replaced by pinned scripts:src:scripts, not copied psutil or shared venv. No VIRTUAL_ENV/PYTHONHOME/DYLD/user startup variables are inherited.

Retain PYTHONVERBOSE import-origin trails: parent_console.log and worker.log. Audit source/cached-module origins against base stdlib/frozen builtins, pinned G1 scripts and (parent only) copied psutil. Namespace origins for task007f/profile1 must be pinned scripts. Reject numerical/backend/controller packages or any mutable current/Safety/CT-1 source origin. Complete log/identity evidence is a prerequisite to interpreting the run; logging is an additional disclosed observer effect.

Check git HEAD equals reviewed SHA and status is empty in pinned checkout; hash all eleven listed G1 executable/test/helper paths and accepted contracts/profile. Invoke launcher from that checkout itself; its ROOT is derived from __file__, not --source-root alone. Never pass the documentation HEAD as reviewed revision without new approval.

Before launch, inventory actual computational processes and all measurement guards in original, pinned, Safety and CT-1 results trees (including D3_ACTIVE). Inspect unknown owners using PID plus command/start identity; do not remove guards. Record the inspection and reservation. Reinspect conflicts during the attempt under separately approved external supervision; implementation alone does not guarantee isolation.

Require paths absent before setup, new output absent before parent command, physical non-symlink parent directories, >=2 GiB free, approved interpreter/dependency/source identity and operator supervision. If this cannot be established, do not launch.

import_separation.parent: Launcher top-level stdlib; _parent imports third-party psutil and pinned threading_study.config, which imports stdlib ctypes/os/pathlib. environment(1) only edits environment values; it does not call configure_accelerate.
import_separation.child: Top-level stdlib, _fresh source checks via git subprocesses, parent guard check, then early return into _clock_worker before native/numerical imports. Recorder is pinned project stdlib-only Python, so stdlib-only means no third-party Python dependency in child apart from this recorder source; git is an external program, not a Python import.
import_separation.native_thread_claim: No BLAS initialization/control API is called on clock path. Child receives VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 but this is not proof that every native thread is controlled; observed process thread counts remain descriptive.
import_separation.runtime_origin_audit_gap: G1 has no structured end-of-worker sys.modules manifest or import sandbox. Proposed verbose logs plus strict path/startup/hash preflight support review, not a mathematical import-infallibility guarantee. If structured enforced origin auditing is required, request a separately reviewed source correction and new execution SHA.

limits.name: worker_interval
limits.actual_enforcement: Soft sampled comparison time.monotonic()-start > 30. start is before log open/Popen; parent import/guard/setup work precedes it. No total-parent deadline.

limits.name: observed_child_RSS
limits.actual_enforcement: Direct-child memory_info().rss > 2**30 at samples; no kernel limit, no descendant/parent sum, fast peaks may be missed.

limits.name: observed_output
limits.actual_enforcement: sum(stat().st_size) of is_file entries under output at samples; logical lengths, hard links may count twice; not envelope/dependency/checkouts, not a quota.

limits.name: initial_free_disk
limits.actual_enforcement: statvfs(output.parent).f_bavail*f_frsize before output mkdir, reject if <2**30*2.

limits.name: remaining_free_disk
limits.actual_enforcement: statvfs(output) at samples, stop if <2**30; check is not a reservation and stops when child poll completes.

resource_proposal.sampling: Sequential loop does psutil CPU/RSS/thread and recursive output/disk work, then time.sleep(0.1); interval is about 100 ms PLUS work/scheduler delays, not an exact 10 Hz guarantee. A very short child may yield no samples.
resource_proposal.termination: Direct child SIGTERM via Popen.terminate; wait(timeout=2); then SIGKILL via kill, followed by unbounded wait. finally repeats cleanup if still alive. Two-second grace and scheduling/export/cleanup can extend wall time beyond 30 s; no 32-second total guarantee.
resource_proposal.process_group: No start_new_session, setsid, process-group signaling or descendant aggregation. Git helper descendants are possible and not group-killed.
resource_proposal.parent_budget: Parent itself has no RSS/output/process-time or whole-command timeout; envelope/logs/preflight/checkouts/dependency copies and final post-child writes lie outside output sampling. No aggregate ten-minute G2 controller is implemented.
resource_proposal.monitor_error: Only psutil.NoSuchProcess is caught in the monitor loop. Other inspection/filesystem/access errors can exit without parent_exit.json; preserve logs and classify incomplete.
resource_proposal.guard: Fresh output/MEASURED_ACTIVE contains owner_pid and fixture, published through .partial/hard link. Child checks owner_pid==os.getppid. finally removes only a readable owner-matching guard after direct child cleanup. Before-try errors, SIGKILL, malformed guard or storage failure can leave it; never remove blindly.
resource_proposal.guard_scope: Automatic scan only pinned launcher ROOT/results/**/MEASURED_ACTIVE and ROOT/results/task007d/D3_ACTIVE, plus seven command substrings. It ignores self and immediate parent PIDs. It is a pre-launch check, not an atomic global reservation or continuous process scan.

separately_authorized_corrections_if_req: Structured module-origin enforcement/evidence in parent and child
Atomic cross-worktree measurement reservation with owner start identity and robust stale guard handling
Process-session/group and descendant supervision, bounded final waits and hard whole-parent deadline
Hard memory/output quotas or aggregate parent+descendant monitoring and final disk/output checks
Guaranteed incomplete/failure manifest on clock-branch exceptions

record_contract.scope: Root key/type contract plus task-specific semantic assertions; not a claim of generic full JSON Schema dialect coverage.
